t: This is Nuffield Lodge, a Grade I listed villa on Prince Albert Road in Regent's Park. Both the house and its gardens fall within the park, which is itself Grade I listed on the Register of Historic Parks and Gardens. The house is owned by the Sultan of Oman. It was designed by Decimus Burton, one of the foremost English architects and landscapers of the nineteenth century, known for his work in the Greek Revival, Roman Revival, Georgian neoclassical and Regency styles.
